terms.gloss: fish as food, a catch of fish
terms.comment: Properly “a fishing”; in comedy also the fish themselves, as food (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: Quid est in ventre piscis, tata?
phrases.english: What’s in the fish’s belly, Dad?

phrases.latin: «In hōc pisce ānulus nōn est, tata.»
phrases.english: “There’s no ring in this fish, Dad.”

phrases.latin: Vidē piscēs versicolōrēs inter cūralia natantēs!
phrases.english: Look at the colourful fish swimming among the coral!

phrases.latin: Plūrima autem et maxima animālia in Indicō marī
phrases.english: But the most and the largest creatures are in the Indian Ocean

sources: Lewis & Short: piscosus · Lewis & Short: versicolor
